/**
 * Redis: set a key with a TTL, then read it back.
 *
 * Uses node-redis v4 (`npm i redis`). The client is created lazily and
 * reused, so repeated calls share one connection pool.
 */
import { createClient, type RedisClientType } from "redis";

export interface SetAndGetOptions {
  /** Redis URL, e.g. redis://localhost:6379 */
  url?: string;
  /** Time-to-live in seconds. Must be > 0. */
  ttlSeconds?: number;
}

export interface SetAndGetResult {
  key: string;
  value: string | null;
  /** Remaining TTL in seconds: -1 = no expiry, -2 = key missing. */
  ttlSeconds: number;
}

let clientPromise: Promise<RedisClientType> | null = null;

function getClient(url: string): Promise<RedisClientType> {
  if (!clientPromise) {
    const client: RedisClientType = createClient({ url });
    client.on("error", (err) => console.error("[redis] client error:", err));
    clientPromise = client.connect().then(() => client);
  }
  return clientPromise;
}

/**
 * SET key value EX ttl, then GET key and TTL key.
 *
 * Complexity: O(1) time and O(1) extra space — three single-key commands.
 */
export async function setWithTtlAndGet(
  key: string,
  value: string,
  { url = "redis://localhost:6379", ttlSeconds = 60 }: SetAndGetOptions = {},
): Promise<SetAndGetResult> {
  if (!Number.isInteger(ttlSeconds) || ttlSeconds <= 0) {
    throw new RangeError(`ttlSeconds must be a positive integer, got ${ttlSeconds}`);
  }

  const client = await getClient(url);

  // SET ... EX is atomic: the key never exists without its expiry.
  await client.set(key, value, { EX: ttlSeconds });

  const [readBack, ttl] = await Promise.all([client.get(key), client.ttl(key)]);

  return { key, value: readBack, ttlSeconds: ttl };
}

    value: str,

        decode_responses=True,
        socket_timeout=5.0,

        # so the key can never exist without its TTL.
        client.set(key, value, ex=ttl_seconds)
        got = client.get(key)
        remaining = client.ttl(key)  # -1 = no expiry, -2 = key missing
        return got, remaining

/**

function batchArray(arr: any[], n: number): any[] {

  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += n) {
